dedupe_keys.name: waitwise nhs referral to treatment wait data pipeline

description: WaitWise ingests NHS England referral-to-treatment waiting statistics and organisation records, joins provider and specialty codes, geocodes 552 providers and stores monthly wait snapshots. The public site states a fifteen-month window from April 2025 to June 2026 and explains that median wait describes the current queue, not an individual patient’s predicted wait. The repository documents refresh commands, data-quality checks and suppression handling. Code is MIT and free; underlying NHS and postcode information carries Open Government Licence 3.0 and related source rights. Coverage is England at provider, specialty and month level, with straight-line distances, not travel times. A limitation is that the repository currently mixes NHS and independent providers without a sector marker, and the official NHS page returned an automated anti-bot challenge during this check. Simulation use includes preparing service-choice and capacity constraints. It complements data-cms-provider-data-hospitals with English wait times. No ingestion was executed.
licence: MIT code; NHS public-sector source data under OGL-3.0 and stated component rights.
